trans-unit.source: I participated in a training program on Artificial Intelligence organized by Ateliers Créactifs, which focused on building, training, and evaluating AI models. The program emphasized hands-on learning with practical applications, enabling me to understand and apply cutting-edge techniques in machine learning and neural networks.

Key Learnings During the training, I gained expertise in managing data pipelines, training machine learning models, and evaluating their performance. I worked on tasks such as preparing datasets, splitting them into training and validation subsets, and creating efficient workflows using DataLoaders. I explored the advantages of transfer learning by using the pre-trained ResNet34 model and fine-tuning it with application-specific data. This approach significantly enhanced the model’s accuracy compared to training a model from scratch. Additionally, I delved into performance evaluation, using precision as a key metric to measure and compare the effectiveness of pre-trained and non-pre-trained models.

Skills Acquired The training equipped me with valuable skills in data manipulation, transfer learning, and performance evaluation, as well as a solid understanding of how to apply pre-trained neural networks to real-world problems. These insights have broadened my expertise in machine learning and prepared me to address practical AI challenges with confidence.

I participated in a Dutch language training program at the Forem training center in Mons. I completed three consecutive courses, starting at level A0, without any prior knowledge of Dutch. By the end of the first course, I reached level A1, then progressed to level A2 after the second course, and finally achieved level B1 upon completing the third course. Each level was certified by the Forem through the ELAO testing system.

Key Learnings Throughout the program, I developed strong skills in understanding and communicating in Dutch. I learned to construct sentences, expand vocabulary, and improve listening, reading, writing, and speaking abilities. The program provided a structured and progressive approach, enabling me to gain confidence in practical, everyday use of the language.

Skills Acquired By the end of the training, I acquired certified proficiency in Dutch at level B1. I can now communicate effectively in a variety of professional and social situations, demonstrating a solid foundation in both written and spoken Dutch.
From 2013 to 2019, I attended Collège Saint-Stanislas in Mons, Belgium, where I completed a rigorous six-year secondary education program and earned my CESS diploma in June 2019.

During my studies, I pursued a specialized track that emphasized both linguistic and scientific subjects: English Immersion: I followed an intensive English immersion program from my third year through to my final year. This included advanced English language courses entirely conducted in English, with no use of French. Vocabulary lists, explanations, and interactions were exclusively in English, fostering complete language immersion. Advanced Sciences in English Immersion: As part of my science track, I studied Physics, Chemistry, and Biology in advanced-level courses taught entirely in English. This allowed me to deepen my knowledge of scientific principles while strengthening my technical vocabulary and communication skills in English. Latin: Throughout my six years of secondary school, I studied Latin, building a strong foundation in classical languages and analytical thinking. Spanish: In my final two years, I added Spanish to my curriculum, attending two hours of lessons per week and developing conversational proficiency.

This diverse and challenging curriculum allowed me to develop strong critical thinking, problem-solving, and multilingual communication skills, which continue to serve me well in academic and professional contexts.

During my internship at ETNIC's Innovation Center (R&D department), I worked as a Fullstack Developer to design and develop an internal web application aimed at document management and interactive chatbot integration. The key feature of this application was its ability to act as a Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) system, allowing users to interactively query and discuss documents stored within the platform. The primary goal was to streamline document-related tasks and enable intuitive access to information, revolutionizing how employees interacted with organizational knowledge.

Key Contributions Throughout this internship, I collaborated closely with a small team of developers, working from the ground up to build a seamless and user-friendly application. My contributions included: Frontend Development: The user interface is built using Angular 17, TypeScript, Angular Material, HTML, and SCSS, ensuring an intuitive and accessible user experience. Backend API Implementation: Developed the backend REST API with Python and FastAPI, ensuring robust performance and scalability. Asynchronous Task Management: Designed an efficient file upload system using Celery and Redis to handle long-running tasks asynchronously. This improved the system's performance and reliability. Chatbot Integration: Implemented a conversational AI chatbot using a RAG architecture powered by LangChain, Mistral AI for the generative AI, and vector search. This allowed users to receive contextualized responses based on document content. Database Management: Managed data storage with MongoDB Atlas for the main database and Redis for caching and task queuing. Testing and Quality Assurance: Wrote and executed tests using Pytest to ensure code reliability and maintainability. Containerization and Deployment: Utilized Docker for containerized development, ensuring consistent environments across local and cloud-based systems on Azure.

Project Methodology We followed the Agile methodology, working in week sprints. The team actively used stories, sprint planning, and retrospectives to ensure iterative progress and clear communication. This collaborative environment helped me gain firsthand experience in professional software development workflows.

Takeaways and Growth This internship was a transformative experience that allowed me to Strengthen my skills in fullstack development by working on a complete project lifecycle. I also explored the integration of generative AI into real-world applications and Deepen my understanding of asynchronous processing and task queues for performance optimization. This project allow me to enhance my teamwork and project management abilities in an Agile environment. By the end of the internship, I had gained invaluable insights into designing innovative solutions and integrating cutting-edge technologies into practical use cases
MES Project Engineer at Technord Mons (03/2026 - Present)

I joined Technord as a MES Project Engineer, working within a company specializing in industrial automation and digitalization. My role focuses on the implementation and integration of Manufacturing Execution Systems using, helping industrial clients bridge the gap between their production floor operations and IT systems.

Key ResponsibilitiesConfiguration & Parametrization: Setting up and tailoring to match each client's specific industrial processes, ensuring the system accurately reflects real production workflows. Development & Customization: Developing custom extensions and adaptations within the MES platform to meet requirements that go beyond out-of-the-box capabilities. Client Deployment: Deploying MES solutions on-site at industrial facilities, coordinating with clients to ensure smooth integration with existing infrastructure and minimal disruption to production. Testing & Validation: Conducting functional tests and validation procedures to guarantee system reliability, data accuracy, and compliance with client specifications before go-live.

Takeaways and Growth This position marks my first step into the world of industrial software, allowing me to combine my software development background with the realities of manufacturing environments. Working directly with clients on complex deployments has strengthened my ability to understand operational needs, adapt technical solutions accordingly, and deliver reliable systems in demanding contexts.
Computer Science, specializing in Application Development HELHa Mons (2021 - 2024)

I completed my Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, specializing in Application Development, at HELHa in Mons. The program trained me as a Fullstack Developer, equipping me with the ability to work on both frontend and backend systems. However, through my projects and practical experiences, I gained more extensive expertise in backend development, where I excel at designing and managing robust systems.

Notable Projects Throughout my studies, I participated in several impactful projects that prepared me for professional challenges: Web Application and APIs: I developed scalable web applications and a mobile application using modern frameworks and tools, integrating APIs and databases into functional, scalable systems. One project used Angular for the frontend, C# (ASP.NET Core) for backend APIs, and SQL Server for database management. The other was developed using Bootstrap for the frontend part and Jakarta EE to create the backend APIs, These projects involved containerization with Docker, ensuring smooth deployment and scalability. Game Development: I created video games using C++ and JavaFX, exploring graphical rendering, game mechanics, and performance optimization. These projects helped me understand low-level programming and interactive system design. Mobile Applications: I built a mobile application using Kotlin and Android Studio, focusing on user experience and seamless integration with backend APIs. Networks and Systems: Learned technical architecture and hardware systems, along with network fundamentals. Websites: Developed web platforms with PHP, leveraging database systems like MySQL and Amazon SQL to ensure efficient data handling and secure user management. Real-World Scenarios: Every project followed a complete software development lifecycle, including requirements gathering, design (with UML and wireframes), coding, testing, and deployment. Additionally, I mastered Scrum and Agile methodologies, regularly applying them to project management, ensuring clear communication, iterative progress, and delivery of high-quality results. These projects often required self-learning of new tools and technologies to meet specific objectives.

Academic Focus The program offered a mix of technical and theoretical courses that broadened my understanding of computer science: Software Development and Design: I explored design patterns, system architecture, and best practices for robust and maintainable software. Mathematics and Machine Learning: I gained a foundation in analytical problem-solving and data-driven systems. Technical Systems and Networks: I studied the fundamentals of networking, hardware, and operating systems, enabling me to understand how software interacts with underlying infrastructure. Business and Communication: Courses in microeconomics, macroeconomics, and English for Computer Scientists enhanced my ability to communicate and collaborate in a professional context.

Final Project (TFE) My thesis, titled "Cody: A Web Application Facilitating Documentation Access Using AI", involved the creation of a Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) system. This project was part of my internship, detailed in its respective section. IT exemplified my ability to combine theoretical knowledge with practical implementation, addressing real-world documentation challenges. It also solidified my skills in fullstack development and collaborative problem-solving.

Personal Growth This program significantly shaped my professional aspirations. I transitioned from mastering the fundamentals of programming to confidently tackling complex projects. Beyond technical expertise, I developed strong skills in project management, teamwork, and problem-solving, which continue to guide my professional journey.
Bachelor's in Computer Science Ecole Polytechnique de l'UCLouvain (2019 - 2021)

After high school, I pursued a Bachelor's in Computer Science at the École Polytechnique de Louvain in Louvain-la-Neuve, studying there for two years. This program created my understanding of programming, algorithms, and the theoretical foundations of computer science and deepened my passion for new technologies.

Programming Courses: Developed strong skills in Python and Java through courses and projects, including the creation of a web application using Python, Flask and HTML or Java application with Unittest and a quiz application in Python. In my second year, I independently learned C to complete a team project. Algorithms and Paradigms: Studied algorithm design and explored different programming paradigms, including concurrency. Foundations of Computer Science: Gained insights into computability, logic, and complexity, as well as the hardware basics of computer science. Language: Developed technical communication skills in English for Computer Scientists.
Although I didn’t complete the program, these courses gave me a solid technical foundation, practical experience, and the ability to adapt quickly to new tools and concepts.

A Belgian with a passion for creating programs and web applications. At, I am now MES Project Engineer at Technord, where I work on the deployment, integration and customization of Manufacturing Execution Systems for industrial clients. My role allows me to combine my background in application development with my interest in software engineering. I also have experience building fullstack applications, developing a RAG system during my internship at ETNIC, and working with technologies such as Docker, SQL, Git, and Agile methodologies. I’m particularly interested in designing reliable software solutions that address concrete technical and business challenges. Feel free to explore my projects and get in touch if you'd like to collaborate!
